## 1. 共通データのセット

```{r}

rm(list = ls(all = TRUE))

# libraries needed
library(tidyverse)  # most variable creation here uses tidyverse 
library(tidyselect) # used to select variables in FP_EVENTS.R
library(haven)      # used for Haven labeled DHS variables
library(labelled)   # used for Haven labeled variable creation
library(expss)      # for creating tables with Haven labeled data
library(rJava)      # required for xlsx package
library(naniar)     # to use replace_with_na function
library(here)       # to get R project path
library(fs)         # for file path manipulation
library(openxlsx) 　# for exporting to excel
library(survey)       # for survey design


# 各種の関数セット読み込み
source("../myTools.R")  # プロジェクトルートから読み込む（quarto限定の処理）

# 対象とする年のリスト
yearlist <- c("2007", "2008", "2009", "2010", "2011",
"2012", "2013", "2014", "2015", "2016")
# yearlist <- c("2008")

# DHSデータのルートフォルダを指定
gdrive_dir <- "/Users/snakada/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-snakada@g.ecc.u-tokyo.ac.jp/マイドライブ/Peru_work/Peru_endes/spss"

# データベース一覧
endes_list <- readRDS(file.path(gdrive_dir, "output","endes_data_list.rds"))

# 変数ラベル一覧
endes_var_labels <- readRDS(file.path(gdrive_dir, "output", "endes_var_labels.rds"))

# ファイル名の設定
files <- c("BRdata-rh","IRdata-rh","IRdata-rc","KRvac","KRdata",
           "KRiycf-nt","WASHdata-ws","IRdata-ms","KRstool")
files2 <- c("PRData")

# RDSファイルを読み込む関数
# year: 年
# filename: ファイル名（拡張子なし）
# select_col: 抽出する列名のベクトル（NULLの場合は全列を抽出）
open_processed_file <- function(year, filename, select_col = NULL) {
  file_path <- file.path(gdrive_dir, "output", year, paste0(filename, ".RDS")) %>%
    normalizePath() %>%
    trimws() # 正規化してトリムする
    if (file_exists(file_path)) {
      df <- readRDS(file_path) %>%
        rename_with(~ tolower(.x))
    if (!is.null(select_col)) {
      df <- df %>% select(all_of(select_col))
    }
    print("重複チェック")
    if (duplicate_check(df, c("caseid"), filename) == 0) {
      duplicate_check_detail(df, c("caseid"), filename)
    }
    return(df)
  } else {
    stop("File does not exist: ", file_path)
  }
}

```

## 2. データ処理

```{r}
# 必要なデータセットの抽出

goAnalysis <- function(year){
  cat("============================================================================\n")
  cat("ENDES データ結合処理開始:", year, "\n")
  cat("============================================================================\n\n")

  print(paste("Processing year:", year))
  # 出力用のルートフォルダを指定
  output_dir <- file.path(gdrive_dir, "output", year) %>%
    normalizePath() %>%
    trimws() # 正規化してトリムする
  # 出力用のルートフォルダが存在しない場合は作成
  if (!dir_exists(output_dir)) {
    dir_create(output_dir)
  }
  
  # 必要なデータセットの抽出
  print("必要なデータセットを抽出します")
  
  keep_RECH1 <- c("HV001", "HV002", "HV103", "HHID", "HVIDX")
  keep_RECH6 <- c("HC1", "hc27", "HC56", "HC70", "HC71", "HC72", "HHID", "HC0")
  data_all <- list()
  data_merged <- NULL
  
  for (f in files){
    print(paste("Loading file:", f))
    data_all[[f]] <- open_processed_file(year, f)
    # if (is.null(data_merged)){
    #   print(paste("Start from file:", f))
    #   data_merged <- data_all[[f]]
    # } else {
    #   print(paste("Merging with file:", f))
    #   left_join_safe(data_merged, data_all[[f]], by = c("caseid" = "caseid"))
    # }
  }
  
  data_merged <- data_all[["BRdata-rh"]]
  print("Merging with IRdata-rh")
  data_merged <- left_join_safe(data_merged, 
    data_all[["IRdata-rh"]], by = c("caseid" = "caseid", "age", "wt"))
  if (nrow(data_merged) == 0) {
    stop("Merging resulted in zero rows. Please check the join keys and data.")
  }
  
  print("Merging with IRdata-rc")
  data_merged <- left_join_safe(data_merged, 
    data_all[["IRdata-rc"]], by = c("caseid" = "caseid", "year"))
  if (nrow(data_merged) == 0) {
    stop("Merging resulted in zero rows. Please check the join keys and data.")
  }
  
  print("Merging with KRvac")
  data_merged <- left_join_safe(data_merged, 
    data_all[["KRvac"]], by = c("caseid" = "caseid", "age", "wt", "year"))
  if (nrow(data_merged) == 0) {
    stop("Merging resulted in zero rows. Please check the join keys and data.")
  }
  
  print("Merging with KRdata")
  data_merged <- left_join_safe(data_merged, 
    data_all[["KRdata"]], by = c("caseid" = "caseid", "age", "wt", "year"))
  if (nrow(data_merged) == 0) {
    stop("Merging resulted in zero rows. Please check the join keys and data.")
  }
  
  print("Merging with KRiycf-nt")
  data_merged <- left_join_safe(data_merged, 
    data_all[["KRiycf-nt"]], by = c("caseid" = "caseid", "b4", "v005", "v022", 
                                    "v025", "v106", "v190", "age", "year"))
  if (nrow(data_merged) == 0) {
    stop("Merging resulted in zero rows. Please check the join keys and data.")
  }
  
  print("Merging with IRdata-ms")
  data_merged <- left_join_safe(data_merged, 
    data_all[["IRdata-ms"]], by = c("caseid" = "caseid", "year"))
  if (nrow(data_merged) == 0) {
    stop("Merging resulted in zero rows. Please check the join keys and data.")
  }
  
  print("Merging with KRstool")
  data_merged <- left_join_safe(data_merged, 
    data_all[["KRstool"]], by = c("caseid" = "caseid", "wt", "age", "year"))
  if (nrow(data_merged) == 0) {
    stop("Merging resulted in zero rows. Please check the join keys and data.")
  }
  
  print("Merging with WASHdata-ws")
  data_all[["WASHdata-ws"]] <- data_all[["WASHdata-ws"]] %>% 
    select(-c(v005, v022, v001, v002))
  data_merged <- left_join_safe(data_merged, 
    data_all[["WASHdata-ws"]], by = c("caseid", "year"))
  if (nrow(data_merged) == 0) {
    stop("Merging resulted in zero rows. Please check the join keys and data.")
  }
  
  print("データセットの抽出と結合が完了しました")

  # ============================================================================
  # 保存
  # ============================================================================
  cat("## 7. ファイル保存\n")
  saveRDS(data_merged, paste0(output_dir, "/data_merged.rds"))
  cat("全データ結合完了:", year, "\n")
  
  cat("============================================================================\n")
  cat("処理完了:", year, ": データ数", nrow(data_merged), "\n")
  cat("============================================================================\n")

  
    
  # return(data_all) # デバッグ用
  return(data_merged)
}

```

## 3. ループ実行

```{r}
#** ここから実行
mydata <- list()
for (yr in yearlist) {
  mydata[[yr]] <- goAnalysis(yr)
}
```
